title: Explainable selection and session pinning
summary: NativeDatabaseBackendPlanner evaluates eligibility and emits explicit rejection reasons such as UNAVAILABLE, FAMILY_MISMATCH and MISSING_CAPABILITY:<name>. Among eligible implementations, the lowest numerical priority wins unless a higher policy layer deliberately changes ranking. Once acquired, the implementation is pinned for the session/transaction.
invariants: UNAVAILABLE is different from missing capability.
UNKNOWN and CONDITIONAL do not count as SUPPORTED for hard eligibility.
Required capabilities can make a lower-preference fallback the only eligible implementation.
Failure after acquisition is surfaced; automatic mid-session or mid-transaction replay is prohibited.
Selection rationale should be publishable to Database Core / NoSQL federation for diagnostics and evidence.

provenance.claim: Fallback selection occurs before session acquisition and post-acquisition failures are surfaced rather than replayed.
